metadata.name: routed-smoke
metadata.description:
End-to-end proof that test-genie's routed test-database path actually works: navigates to a DB-backed view and asserts that a fixture slug seeded into the per-run test pool ('routed-smoke-001') is rendered. The slug exists only in the test pool; if the API failed to route the request to the test pool (e.g., X-Vrooli-Test-Mode header not attached, TestModeMiddleware missing, RoutedDB.pick(ctx) returning the primary), the assertion fails.

SCAFFOLD: this case cannot pass until you (a) point scenario_path and the assert selector at a real DB-backed list view in your scenario and (b) write bas/seeds/seed.go so it inserts a record carrying 'routed-smoke-001' into the test pool. It deliberately references no example-domain selector, so it survives `template-manager lifecycle detemplate` intact.

metadata.label: DB-backed view visible (repoint at your list container)

assert.failure_message: Seeded fixture 'routed-smoke-001' not visible — either bas/seeds/seed.go does not insert it yet, this case still points at the placeholder dashboard selector rather than your DB-backed list, or the UI->API request did not reach the routed test pool. Check that X-Vrooli-Test-Mode is attached by Playwright (browser_profile.extra_headers), that TestModeMiddleware is mounted, and that the list's repository uses *database.RoutedDB.

metadata.label: Assert seeded slug is rendered (proves routing end-to-end)
